```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
```


## Part 1


```{r}
input <- read_json("input/12")
input |>
  unlist() |>
  str_subset("\\d+") |>
  as.integer() |>
  sum()
```

111754


## Part 2


```{r}
inp <- read_lines("input/12")

str_view(
  #r"([1,{"c":"red","b":2},3])",
  inp,
  "\\{[^\\{\\}]*\"red\"[^\\{\\}]*\\},?"
)


str_remove_all(
  inp,
  "\"[^\"]+\":\\{[^\\{\\}]*\"red\"[^\\{\\}]*\\},?"
) |>
  fromJSON() |>
  unlist() |>
  str_subset("\\d+") |>
  as.integer() |>
  sum()
```


106951 too high
103653 too high, expected 65402


```{r}
str_remove_all(
  "[1,{\"c\":\"red\",\"b\":2},3]",
  pattern = "\"[^\"]+\"\\s*:\\s*\\{[^\\{\\}]*\"red\"[^\\{\\}]*\\},\\s*"
) |>
  fromJSON() |>
  unlist() |>
  str_subset("\\d+") |>
  as.integer()
```
